summary.one_liner: Cozy-Stack is the core server of the Cozy personal cloud platform, serving installed web apps and exposing a REST API for documents, auth, email, jobs and replication.
summary.what_it_does: The Cozy-Stack is a single server process that serves web applications installed by users from an app store. It exposes a REST API to create, update and delete documents in its database, authenticate users and client apps, send emails, and launch one-time or periodic jobs. Connectors that import data from remote websites run as jobs, and those executing third-party code are sandboxed with nsjail. It also provides a database replication API so local databases, such as those in mobile clients, can sync with the server. Authentication uses session tokens for server-side web apps and OAuth2 for other applications.
use_cases: running web apps on your own server
importing data from remote websites via connectors
how_to_run: Follow the Install guide referenced in the README
Read the configuration documentation referenced in the README
